title: Save the Date: Luxembourg Software Testing Event 2024
excerpt: We are delighted to announce the date of the next Luxembourg Software Testing Event…
description: Luxembourg Software Testing Event 2024 on Thursday 17 October: accessibility, artificial intelligence and automation on the programme. Save the date.
seoTitle: Save the Date: Luxembourg Software Testing Event 2024 - Q-Leap
body:
We are delighted to announce the date of the next Luxembourg Software Testing Event, the largest gathering of testers in Luxembourg. Save Thursday 17 October 2024 to dive into the world of software testing and discover the latest trends and hot topics, such as accessibility testing, artificial intelligence and automation.

This major gathering is a must for software testing and information system quality professionals. Well established in the Luxembourg digital landscape, the event returns in 2024 for an even richer and livelier edition.

On the programme: seminars, presentations and discussion sessions to broaden your knowledge, get the latest market insights and meet recognised experts in the field. It is also a unique opportunity to connect with other major players in the industry.

Registration is now open and admission is free. Don’t miss this unique opportunity to keep up with the innovations in the field and meet industry experts.

To register, find out more and stay informed of updates, visit lste.lu.
